newsitem.title: USA: Pinnacle restructures, sees $4 mln Q3 charge in Q3.
newsitem.headline: Pinnacle restructures, sees $4 mln Q3 charge in Q3.

text.p: Pinnacle Micro Inc said Wednesday it will take a one-time charge of about $4 million in its third quarter l996 for restructuring and for revising its purchasing contract.
The company said it will consolidate and move manufacturing operations from its headquarters in Irvine to its development and manufacturing offices in Colorado Springs, Colorado.
The data technology company said it will cut jobs in Irvine and add jobs in Colorado Springs.
The company said the charge also covers a plan to outsource certain key functions and severance costs.
The company said it believes the consolidation, sales of its Apex4.6 GB optical drive and outsourcing "will position Pinnacle to return to profitability in 1997."
The company said it is still on schedule to begin shipping the Apex4.6 GB optical drive in the fourth quarter.
The company said its contract revision charge involves an order with a key supplier, but did not specify further.
